title: Divisible by 5 Without Dividing
constraints: `d5 = 1` when the unsigned 16-bit `x` is divisible by 5.
No `/`, `%`, `mod` or `rem`, and no loops. Purely combinational.
hints: 16 ≡ 1 (mod 5), so a number is congruent to the **sum of its hex digits** modulo 5, just like casting out nines in decimal.
Sum the four nibbles (at most 60), fold again (the sum's upper bits are worth 16 ≡ 1 as well), and finish with a small comparison against {0, 5, 10, 15}.
